rv.q: It's enormously silly and tremendous fun – no doubt Bennett took himself a bit more seriously in the original, but not too much.
Overall, this staging of The Grand Babylon Hotel at Hull Truck Theatre is an entertaining and briskly paced production, buoyed by humour and several spirited performances.
If you're after an evening of theatre that doesn't take itself too seriously, delivers plenty of laughs, and reminds you why live theatre is such a joy, this one is absolutely worth checking into.

cn.t: Critics praise this wonderfully over-the-top adaptation of Arnold Bennett's farce, celebrating its rollicking comedy and continuous laughter. The five-actor ensemble earns acclaim for their energetic performances across multiple colorful roles.
